title: LGD districts register
description: Authoritative register of every Indian district, keyed on the LGD numeric district id issued by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj's Local Government Directory. FK to datasets/taxonomy/lgd_states.json on lgd_state_id. The canonical INTERNAL join authority for every district-keyed indicator per ADR-0050 + docs/concepts/lgd-authority.md. Refreshed from datasets/taxonomy/lgd/districts-latest.csv via tools/migrate/build_lgd_districts.py.

x-changelog.summary: Initial schema. 784 districts across all 36 states/UTs from LGD CSV snapshot 2026-05-24. Bifurcation lineage (parent_district_lgd) intentionally NOT in v1.0 - source CSV does not carry it; will arrive in a follow-up ingest from the LGD district-history page.

lgd_district_id.description: LGD numeric district id (Ministry of Panchayati Raj). Globally unique across India.

lgd_name.description: Canonical English name as published by LGD.

slug.description: Kebab-case ASCII slug. Unique WITHIN a state (name collisions across states like 'Hamirpur' in HP and UP get a numeric salt).

census_2001_code.description: Census 2001 numeric district code (null if district did not exist or was unmapped in 2001).

census_2011_code.description: Census 2011 numeric district code (null if district did not exist or was unmapped in 2011).
